title: Syrian Stew with Lamb
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Syria, featuring tender lamb and a rich blend of spices. This comforting dish is perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Syrian stew
ingredients.notes: Available in most Middle Eastern stores

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the Syrian stew, lamb broth, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Return the browned lamb to the pot, cover, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
